title: Zesty Australian Mozzarella Bowl
description: A vibrant one-pot bowl that marries silky mozzarella pearls with a zesty, sweet-savory broth, finished with a glassy sheen and a dash of sriracha heat.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add diced onion, carrot and celery and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and smoked paprika, cooking until fragrant for 1 minute.
Pour in vegetable broth and soy sauce, bringing to a gentle simmer.
Add honey and lime juice, stirring until the liquid thickens slightly into a glossy reduction.
Gently fold in the mozzarella balls, letting them warm through without blooming, about 2 minutes.
Add a teaspoon of sriracha, tasting and adjusting seasoning as needed.
Transfer the mixture to bowls and serve hot.
